name: variance-analysis
description: Sales and management-accounting variance analysis with reviewable calculations, plots, drilldowns, and driver interpretation.

interface.shortDescription: Run sales or accounting variance analysis with reviewable outputs, drilldowns, and waterfall plots.
interface.longDescription: Self-contained variance workflow for CSV or Excel sales and management-accounting datasets. It inspects columns, confirms unresolved mappings, supports amount-only period comparisons and price/volume/mix when reviewed unit data exists, prepares legacy-backed YTD or rolling period buckets when requested, and runs the applicable calculation and visualization package: net-of-discount and margin totals, Price / Units / Mix decomposition ladder, fixed-dimension and exploded parent/child bridges, root-cause variance across dimension combinations, alternative sweep, automatic drilldowns, waterfall and small-multiples PNGs, diagnostics, structured context files, source packs, professional-review Word drafts, accounting-control audit outputs, and reviewed driver interpretation. The scripts do not make direct model API calls.
defaultPrompt: Use Variance Analysis on the sales or management-accounting CSV or Excel file I provide.

Inspect the columns, confirm the comparison and mappings, run the complete applicable variance package including plots and drilldowns, write the review artifacts, and interpret only source-supported drivers.
